name: Listen: a free AI voice reader
objective: Add a Listen control to the web reader that reads a document, or a whole book chapter after chapter, aloud in English or Korean with a free AI voice (a free API or a free model, chosen by ear from samples), playable on the operator's phone with the screen off; it skips quizzes, code and source lists, and reads a visual's text alternative instead of skipping it when the document has one.

review.note: round 1: F1 Listen reads the plain Sources section and empty-section headings aloud; F2 speed and follow along kept per document, not per listener (F3 of the design); F3 a book Listen borrows the other language's titles and kept place; 11-listen job still marked signed
